source_boundary: Rechecked primary KnightCap paper cs/9901002 Figure3 and sections2-4, plus original saved METHOD87. No producer/eta/lambda/source/cap change.
interpretation: SelfEvery lambda=.95 discounts one observed halfmove; SelfCandidate/Fixed lambda=.95 discounts one candidate-turn interval (typically two halfmoves). Therefore SelfEvery versus SelfCandidate changes physical trace horizon as well as observed nodes. It is a complete training-regime contrast, not isolated observation-count causality.

Each training selfplay trajectory uses one frozen theta for both actors and search internals. Fixednu trajectories use theta-minimax only at candidate turns, nu-minimax at foe turns. This aligns an internal policy context hypothesis, but data and number of episodes change under equal paid nodes.

KnightCap Figure3 gives episode PV-gradient TD but its headline learning started from expert material and played external online opponents with richer features. It does NOT establish selfplay superiority; this study explicitly tests rather than assumes that. Current price-only/D2/q0/shuffled ties/four randominitials is not full Beal-Smith or KnightCap reproduction.
Tie-selected PV derivative is a branch choice, not a unique classical gradient at ties; same seeded action-path ordering and strict comparison are fixed across regimes.

Chess available draw claims use existing common legal claim policy. Material-only fixeddepth evaluates checked cutoff states as a stated heuristic; no illegal standpat qsearch claim. Generic full typed actions/promotions/drops/history retained.

Chess fixedP and Generic all6free are distinct parameterizations. SAME learner and search code transfers; successful standard Chess learning is not established merely by engineering/math PASS, nor does a generic result establish arbitrary rule learnability.
next_if_negative: Inspect paid trajectory diversity and endpoint/credit usefulness; do not select a best seed, increase eta from DEV, revive prover prerequisite, or extend old caps.

receding_horizon_clarification_before_fi.scope: Selfplay aligns evaluator coefficients, not an exact joint-policy critic. A rootD2 search models opponent at one remainingply; actual opponent starts a newD2 search. Even SAMEtheta therefore retains finitehorizon/replanning mismatch. Neither tanhmaterial nor backedupscore is calibrated WDL/probability. Removal of nu coefficient mismatch is a regime hypothesis, not complete policy-value consistency or diagnosis.
